biggest_catch: The full $600 requires keeping a $10,000 average monthly balance at Verve for a full 12 months — the first $200 is far easier (just $1,000 in direct deposits).
catches: One tiered offer — do not split. Accounts must be opened by December 31, 2026.

$200 Welcome Bonus: open a new eligible Verve checking account and receive qualifying ACH direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 into the new checking account within the first two full calendar months after account opening.
$200 Three-Month Balance Bonus: maintain an average monthly balance of at least $10,000 in qualifying Verve deposit accounts during the first three full calendar months.
$200 Twelve-Month Balance Bonus: maintain an average monthly balance of at least $10,000 in qualifying Verve deposit accounts through the first 12 full calendar months.
Qualifying deposit accounts for the balance bonuses include checking, savings, money market, certificates, IRAs, and HSAs.
You do not need to complete every tier — you can earn just the $200 welcome bonus without maintaining the $10,000 balance.
Verve checking account must be open and in good standing at the time each bonus is paid.
New members only: must not have had a Verve Checking or Membership Share account within the past 18 months; limit one bonus offer per person.
Must be eligible for Verve membership and purchase/maintain a $5.00 ownership share in a savings account.

Optimum Checking carries a $15 monthly fee (waived with a Verve credit card or $10,000 combined deposit average balance); Premier Checking carries a $5 fee (waived with a Verve credit card or $2,000 combined deposit average balance); Essential Checking has no monthly fee.
Bonuses are treated as interest and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

steps: Open a new eligible Verve checking account by December 31, 2026.
Receive qualifying ACH direct deposits totaling at least $1,000 within the first two full calendar months for the $200 welcome bonus.
Optionally maintain a $10,000 average monthly balance across qualifying Verve deposit accounts for the first 3 months (+$200) and through 12 months (+$200).
Keep the checking account open and in good standing; each bonus pays within 30 days after its qualification period.
Expect all bonuses to be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
